name: Andora (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Andora (a red cross on white with a yellow bend).
history: Municipal flag of Andora, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Andora arms — red cross on white with a yellow bend
